Name: HAL for RoT unit as a secure-coprocessor
Description: TitanSSL: software infrastructure exploiting the OpenTitan-based Root-of-Trust as a secure co-processor to secure and accelerate network-stack crypto functions (SHA-256, HMAC, AES) from Linux: OpenSSL/LibSSL engine, Linux Kernel Module bridging to OpenTitan via SCMI mailbox, and OpenTitan firmware serving application requests (OTTEE-V scheme, GlobalPlatform TEE Client API). Uses OpenTitan secure storage for security-sensitive data. FPGA-implemented on VCU118.
Comment: ISOLDE WI ID 4.2.07; same branch as TitanCFI (ips/cfi-ot-firmware.json); IP cards on GitHub (pulp-unibo/isolde_ip_cards).
